note: Germany lost the bet through a 0-0 draw even though money, share and price remained supportive into kickoff. This is a useful failure case: strong SXF confirmation is not sufficient by itself when the football counter-case remains material; do not retroactively weaken the recorded PRE signal because the result failed.
